template/library#

Named text templates, for partials of section templates.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let partials = TemplateLibrary(["item": TextTemplate("  - {{title}}\n")]);
SectionTemplate(source: "{{#items}}{{>item}}{{/items}}", partials: partials);

Description#

Named text templates, for partials of section templates.

Names are exact: no trimming or case folding. template/engine's TemplatePartials is the one library of the engine (#178); SectionTemplate turns a TemplateLibrary into it.

object TemplateLibrary#

object TemplateLibrary

Immutable ordered library, empty by default. Sequence constructors snapshot size once then each ascending item once, rejecting invalid size/excess count before item access. Optional nonnegative maximum_templates defaults to 1024; zero permits an empty source. Duplicates are checked after the full snapshot. Original source failures propagate; no cursor/first/last/close calls. Queries never revisit the source. Missing names throw MissingTemplate, while membership returns false, including for "". Returned values/names outlive us. Retains TextTemplate owners; no resource acquisition, compilation or destroy. O(n) references; duplicates and lookups go through a map of names (#178). The count does not limit source bytes; TextTemplate owns compile/output limits. Example: TemplateLibrary(NamedTemplate("greeting",TextTemplate("Hello"))); Partial expansion is a separate contract: this module only names templates. Run: okkama run -t std/template/library.ok
